result.description:
Media Digital Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Digital Executive (also known as Digital Account Executive, Senior Digital Executive, Senior Digital Account Executive)
The Digital Executive ensures digital implementation/buying excellence across their clients, with the following deliverables: 
•	Leads the implementation of digital media plans once approved. This includes tagging, trafficking, booking, and campaign set up in biddable media platforms. 
•	Leads the management of live campaigns to ensure pacing is on track and performance is optimised. 
•	Responsible for the reporting and post-analysis output for digital campaigns. 
•	Responsible for the management of billing across the client patch, with the support of the coordinator. 
•	Manages tasks including competitive analysis, administration, and ad spec updates, and develops strong relationships with the creative agency 
•	Manages & Trains Digital Coordinator and works proactively with the Digital Account Manager and specialists on campaign deliverables. 
•	Presents at client WIPs and post-analysis meetings. Will also present implementation decks on clients where the Digital Executive has independent charge.
•	Day-to-day contact for small clients when dealing with billing and creative specs queries. 

EXPERIENCE: 
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	1-2 years’ experience minimum preferably in a media related industry but not necessarily agency 
•	Competent in digital buying fundamentals and relevant digital tools 
•	Demonstrate a solid understanding of Australian digital media 
Salary: $85K - $90K package

Digital Manager (Also known as Account Manager, Senior Digital Manager)
The purpose of the Digital Manager is to create/run digital media plan responses through all stages- approach, plans, optimisation, PCR; billing whether its the client, creative agency, media owner, etc. Deliver best in market implementation planning responses: well thought out, argued, and answers the marketing challenge. Looks to innovate where possible, however also nails the fundamentals. First point of contact on day-to-day management of implementation elements. Manage the workloads, outputs and development of the Exec and Coordinators. Support the AD in overall team management, and the GBD and other members of the team in integrating digital into the client advertising mix
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Digital marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $115K package
Digital Director (Also known as Account Director)
The purpose of the Digital Director is to work closely with the Business Director in driving client business growth by unlocking the client’s business opportunity and the capability, delivering outstanding client service, innovative and ambitious client solutions and driving communication planning excellence.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams.
Salary – over threshold

result.description:
Metal City Roofing offers expert construction services for commercial buildings, warehouses, offices, and retail spaces across Adelaide and South Australia. Whether you’re planning a new build or expanding your current premises, we specialise in delivering functional, modern, and code-compliant buildings—all up to two-storey high.

We understand the unique needs of business and industry—every project is tailored to suit operational requirements, site conditions, and budget. Backed by years of experience and a skilled construction team, we deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality builds with a focus on longevity and compliance.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join our team of professionals. We are looking for reliable individuals with a strong commitment to positively contribute to the success of our organisation.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Conduct regular inspections and maintenance of machinery and equipment to ensure optimal operation
Prepare drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials
Optimise mechanical efficiency by adjusting machinery and equipment settings
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation
Supports improvement projects
Fabricates and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills and experiences we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Vacancy Listing Dates 14/07/2026 to 11/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17590
- Immediate start available
- Remuneration: $95,000 - $110,000 per annum
- Join the team at CTI Xpress Systems in Welshpool, WA

CTI Xpress Systems is a transport business with its office located in Welshpool, Perth, offering a range of services to a diverse group of customers throughout Australia.

CTI Xpress Systems is looking for a full-time accountant with minimum of 1-2 years’ experience with data analysis skills.

The role requires a level of management accounting skills with commercial acumen and ability to apply analytical skills to problem solving. The position will report directly to the General Manager and will have the support of a finance team that works across the CTI Logistics Group.

The role will include or require the following:
- A focus on revenue capture and margin improvement.
- Cost and margin analysis in order to assist management in making informed decisions.
- Streamline business processes.
- Data analysis and reporting.
- KPI reporting and benchmarking.
- Customer rate table analysis and review.
- Produce management and operational reports with analysis and insights.
- Supporting staff in the use and configuration of software, systems and procedures to operational advantage.

To be considered you should have the following:
- Relevant tertiary qualifications in a business related discipline.
- Minimum 1-2 years working within a finance, accounting or related field.
- Strong analytical, communication and problem solving skills.
- Experience in preparing budgets
- Background understanding of financial systems and processes.
- Experience in transport and logistics and software associated within those industries.
- Working experience with snowflake database and Power BI
- Demonstrated experience in reviewing systems and procedures to identify efficiencies.
- Ensuring business practices adhere to internal controls.
- Moderate to Advanced skills in Microsoft packages, primarily Excel and Power BI.
- Technical and analytical skills with the ability to maintain, troubleshoot and support software.
- Experience required in Able and Accume financial systems.
- Preparation and review of month end financial accounts.
- Troubleshooting financial discrepancies.
- Analysing and evaluating costs against operational activities.
- General overview and maintenance of financial systems.
- Ensuring business practices adhere to internal controls.

The following attributes are important:
- Reliable and hard working.
- Enjoys working in a team environment.
- Resilient and results oriented.
- Effective planning and prioritisation skills.

A remuneration package of $95,000 - $110,000 per annum will be offered to the successful candidate. An immediate start is available.

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been looking for, please apply through the online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17590.php
